title: SumX
description: Consider a set of n distinct positive integers a1, a2, …, an, having values between 1 and 1000000 and an integer x. Write a program to determine the number of pairs (ai, aj), where 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n and ai + aj = x.
inputDesc: The first line of the standard input contains the integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000). The second line contains n integers – the elements of the set. On the third line the integer x is given (1 ≤ x ≤ 2000000) .
outputDesc: The program should output on a single line of the standard output an integer – the calculated number of pairs.
